The '''Bomodon system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Churba sector/Legends|Churba sector]], within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bomodon]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Bomodon (species)|Bomodon]] [[Species/Legends|species]].
